act.integrity_scope: Crop content hash and source stat; full source volume not hashed

atn.integrity_scope: Crop content hash and source stat; full source volume not hashed

report.source_ids_semantics: Candidate dictionary IDs; final selected mask is candidate tissue AND ROI

geometry.roi_semantics: Sphere, or union of balls whose centers and radii interpolate linearly along each ordered segment; round caps
geometry.orientation: native array interpretation; anatomical orientation and physical origin unverified

volume.roi_surface_sampling: full native Boolean ROI mask; voxel-boundary marching cubes
volume.sampling: block maximum binary occupancy; occupied display blocks may enlarge anatomy
volume.volume_boundary: one zero occupancy block around crop; .5 boundary intersects crop edge
volume.coordinates: native index times spacing in mm; physical origin and orientation unverified
volume.static_renderer: marching-cubes translucent surfaces of the same occupancy grid
volume.static_opacity: selected surfaces enhanced up to .8; context retains configured opacity; zero stays zero

edit.strength_semantics: Maximum weighted six-neighbor path length in mm; edge costs equal axis spacing. Axis-biased grid metric, not Euclidean radius, diameter ratio, or clinical stenosis.
edit.scalar_status: attenuation_proxy_per_pixel copies the winning original target/recipient source voxel value on accepted changes. This is a display proxy, not AI recovery or a physical CT reconstruction. Source atn remains unchanged.
edit.ownership_tie_break: Shortest accepted six-edge physical path, then lowest signed original ID, then earliest original source k,j,i coordinate.

figures.area_semantics: Native axial target area inside ROI; not vessel-normal area or clinical stenosis

after_volume.static_renderer: marching-cubes translucent surfaces of the same occupancy grid
after_volume.static_opacity: selected surfaces enhanced up to .8; context retains configured opacity; zero stays zero
